scroll.quote:
From Darkness to Light
Raising the Leaders of Tomorrow
scroll.intro: Welcome to Lahan Manakamana Secondary English Boarding School in Lahan-8, Siraha. Read the latest notices, apply for admission, or sign in to check results.
scroll.cardsIntro: Every child is a light waiting to shine. Lahan Manakamana nurtures curiosity, kindness and discipline, so that each student grows in knowledge and character and steps into the world ready to lead and to care for others.

cards.title: Kindergarten to Class 10
cards.text: One school for every stage, from a child's first day in Kindergarten to the SEE in Class 10.

image.alt: A kindergarten child showing her painted hands, with her teachers

cards.title: Learning With Technology
cards.text: Students work on computers in the school's own computer lab.

image.alt: Students working in the computer lab

cards.title: Sports and Teamwork
cards.text: Football, sports week and the friendships made on the field.

image.alt: The school cricket team in their red tracksuits

cards.title: Art and Creativity
cards.text: Painting, drawing and rangoli bring out every child's imagination.

image.alt: Students drawing and painting at their desks

cards.title: Celebrating Together
cards.text: Saraswati Puja, Akshararambha and festivals shared as one school family.

cards.title: Awards and Achievements
cards.text: Every term ends with a prize-giving that honours first, second and third places.

image.alt: Teachers and students presenting a shield at a school ceremony
